subplans.title: Private production deployment on Netlify
subplans.outcome: The catalog is deployed to a recreated Netlify site from the private GitHub repository with secrets only in Netlify env vars, and the production smoke confirms login, page protection and token enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Production-smoke fixtures fail on a broken login, a missing redirect, a registry file served without or with a wrong token, source in a refusal body and missing configuration.
The deployed site accepts the owner login, redirects anonymous page requests and refuses registry files, index.json and llms.txt without or with a wrong token while serving them with the valid token.

The Button installs from the registry into a fresh app that builds on the composed foundation.
The full verify pipeline passes on the composed foundation.
P1 demos, auth, browse and entry suites pass together through login on the composed tree.
Every implemented or validated P1 entry installs through the app's protected registry route into a fresh consumer that builds.
The verify pipeline passes on the composed MVP tree.
P1, P2, capability, Bencho and catalog suites pass together through login on the composed tree.
Every implemented or validated control entry installs through the protected registry route into a fresh consumer that builds.
The verify pipeline passes on the composed control-family tree.
The complete browser matrix, including the reduced-motion project, passes against the production build.
The acceptance harness installs every implemented or validated entry and at least one per source into fresh consumers that build.

The verify pipeline passes on the final tree.
